primaryChecks.text: Jotham ran away and fled, and went to Beer and lived there, for fear of Abimelech his brother.
primaryChecks.previousContext: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, “You rise and fall on us; for as the man is, so is his strength.” Gideon arose, and killed Zebah and Zalmunna, and took the crescents that were on their camels’ necks.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Abimelech was prince over Israel three years.
